name: Unidirectional Volume Boundary Estimator
definition: A Monte Carlo estimator that samples volume boundary paths by building a main path from detector to light, then constructing side paths from main path vertices to the volume boundary and then to the light.
summary: The Unidirectional Volume Boundary Estimator is a Monte Carlo method that efficiently samples volume boundary paths by building a main path from the camera and attaching side paths to the boundary.
